title: KeyboardShortcutsSheet
wrapsNative: android.app.Activity.onProvideKeyboardShortcuts and Activity.requestShowKeyboardShortcuts (the system Keyboard Shortcuts Helper), with androidx.compose.ui.input.key.onKeyEvent
summary: An app declares its keyboard shortcuts to the system in Activity.onProvideKeyboardShortcuts, and the system's Keyboard Shortcuts Helper lists them (Meta+/ or requestShowKeyboardShortcuts()). Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: Declare a KeyboardShortcutGroup per area with a KeyboardShortcutInfo per shortcut, handle the keys in Compose with onKeyEvent or onPreviewKeyEvent, and offer a "Keyboard shortcuts" menu item that calls requestShowKeyboardShortcuts().
whenNotToUse: Do not build an in-app sheet that copies the system list; it would drift from the shortcuts the system shows. Do not take shortcuts the system reserves (Meta combinations, Alt+Tab).
api: override fun onProvideKeyboardShortcuts(data: MutableList<KeyboardShortcutGroup>, menu: Menu?, deviceId: Int)
KeyboardShortcutInfo(label: CharSequence?, keycode: Int, modifiers: Int)
appearance: The list is drawn by the system in its own style; Monarch does not theme it.
platformNotes: The web KeyboardShortcutsSheet is a side sheet opened with "?" that lists groups of shortcuts, can be filtered and shows the Command or Control symbol for the platform. On Android the list is the system's Keyboard Shortcuts Helper: the activity returns its groups from onProvideKeyboardShortcuts, and the system shows them, with its own system shortcuts, when the person presses Meta+/ or the app calls requestShowKeyboardShortcuts(). Filtering and the modifier symbols are the system's. The labels are the app's localised strings. Only matters with a hardware keyboard. iPadOS shows its own list in the same way.
accessibility: System behavior: the system shortcuts list is accessible to TalkBack and to keyboard navigation.
Every shortcut must also be reachable without a keyboard, through a visible control.
edgeCases: Without a hardware keyboard requestShowKeyboardShortcuts() may show nothing.
Shortcuts handled in onPreviewKeyEvent run before a focused text field gets the key; check the modifiers so typing is not taken.

examples.title: From a help button
examples.setupTemplate:
val keyNames = mapOf("mod" to "⌘", "arrowdown" to "↓", "arrowup" to "↑", "enter" to "↵", "escape" to "Esc")
fun cap(key: String) = keyNames[key] ?: key.uppercase()
class Shortcut(val label: String, val keys: List<List<String>>, val sequence: Boolean = false)
val sections = listOf(
    null to listOf(
        Shortcut({{sections.0.items.0.label}}, listOf({{sections.0.items.0.keys}}.split("+").map(::cap))),
        Shortcut({{sections.0.items.1.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.0.items.1.keys}})))),
    ),
    {{sections.1.group}} to listOf(
        Shortcut({{sections.1.items.0.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.0.keys}})))),
        Shortcut({{sections.1.items.1.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.1.keys.0}})), listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.1.keys.1}})))),
        Shortcut({{sections.1.items.2.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.2.keys.0}})), listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.2.keys.1}})))),
        Shortcut({{sections.1.items.3.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.3.keys}})))),
        Shortcut({{sections.1.items.4.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.1.items.4.keys}})))),
    ),
    {{sections.2.group}} to listOf(
        Shortcut({{sections.2.items.0.label}}, listOf({{sections.2.items.0.keys}}.split(" ").map(::cap)), sequence = true),
        Shortcut({{sections.2.items.1.label}}, listOf({{sections.2.items.1.keys}}.split(" ").map(::cap)), sequence = true),
        Shortcut({{sections.2.items.2.label}}, listOf(listOf(cap({{sections.2.items.2.keys}})))),
    ),
)
examples.setup:
val keyNames = mapOf("mod" to "⌘", "arrowdown" to "↓", "arrowup" to "↑", "enter" to "↵", "escape" to "Esc")
fun cap(key: String) = keyNames[key] ?: key.uppercase()
class Shortcut(val label: String, val keys: List<List<String>>, val sequence: Boolean = false)
val sections = listOf(
    null to listOf(
        Shortcut("Search and commands", listOf("mod+k".split("+").map(::cap))),
        Shortcut("Show this list", listOf(listOf(cap("?")))),
    ),
    "Tasks" to listOf(
        Shortcut("Create task", listOf(listOf(cap("c")))),
        Shortcut("Next task", listOf(listOf(cap("j")), listOf(cap("arrowdown")))),
        Shortcut("Previous task", listOf(listOf(cap("k")), listOf(cap("arrowup")))),
        Shortcut("Select the focused task", listOf(listOf(cap("x")))),
        Shortcut("Open the focused task", listOf(listOf(cap("enter")))),
    ),
    "Navigation" to listOf(
        Shortcut("Go to inbox", listOf("g i".split(" ").map(::cap)), sequence = true),
        Shortcut("Go to projects", listOf("g p".split(" ").map(::cap)), sequence = true),
        Shortcut("Close panel or clear selection", listOf(listOf(cap("escape")))),
    ),
)
